purpose: Define the engineering/scientific interface for a genuinely gripper-selective visual attack before any new real-model qualification exposure.

definition.clean_reference: direct generated action token sequence from the official clean model.generate path using the frozen prompt/input_ids
definition.adversarial_reference: direct generated action token sequence from the same official model.generate path using the frozen prompt/input_ids and adversarial pixel_values
definition.arm_invariant: adversarial direct-generated token_ids[0:6] == clean direct-generated token_ids[0:6]
definition.clean_gripper_requirement: clean direct-generated token_ids[6] is not in the native OPEN class
definition.gripper_transition: clean direct-generated gripper token is not native OPEN and adversarial direct-generated gripper token is native OPEN
definition.target_token_id_role: secondary diagnostic; native OPEN class is primary
definition.clean_vs_adv_comparison: same prompt/input_ids, same deterministic decoding, no decode-to-action-to-token re-encoding
definition.physical_action_execution: only the directly decoded adversarial action may reach env.step after all structural gates pass

required_gates_before_attacked_env_step: clean direct-generated gripper execution class != NATIVE_OPEN
arm token IDs exact equality at dimensions 0..5
adversarial direct-generated gripper execution class = NATIVE_OPEN

mismatch_diagnosis.prefix_spillover: clean and adversarial prompt/input_ids are identical, token counts are valid, and one or more direct generated arm tokens differ
mismatch_diagnosis.decode_index_mismatch: prompt length or exact generated-token extraction differs before the arm comparison
mismatch_diagnosis.validator_error: direct generated token arrays are equal but the validator reports an arm mismatch
mismatch_diagnosis.actuator_overwrite: any env action/token replacement after direct generation; forbidden

repair_candidate_policy.name: STRICT_CANDIDATE_AUDIT_V1
repair_candidate_policy.selection_rule: select the first candidate satisfying every required gate, including clean non-OPEN to adversarial native-OPEN transition; otherwise return STRUCTURAL_INVALID_NO_SELECTIVE_CANDIDATE
repair_candidate_policy.old_final_only_route: immutable historical Q3-F01 context; not reused

historical_boundary.q3_f02: SEALED_NOT_STARTED; do not start under old Q3 authority
